name: Mirror App – Video Feed
author: mirrorapp

sections.description:
Display videos from YouTube on your WordPress site using a clean, customizable video feed. Embed channels or playlists with a shortcode.

Benefits

  • Automatically display new videos on your website
  • Show video content directly on your site without manual updates
  • No API keys or technical setup required

Why Mirror App YouTube Feed?

  • Simple setup – Configure everything in Mirror App. No API keys, tokens, or coding required.
  • Automatic updates – Your feed refreshes itself as new videos, playlists, and Shorts are published.
  • Customizable design – Choose from multiple layouts, adjust spacing, fonts, colors, and more to blend with your site’s design.
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly – The video feed adapts beautifully on desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
  • Multi-source support – Display content from channels, playlists, or combinations thereof.
  • Improved engagement – Showcasing your latest YouTube content directly on your site increases views and keeps visitors engaged.
  • Reliable support – Mirror App is actively maintained with ongoing improvements and support.

Features

  • Shortcode: [mirror-app-video-feed uuid]
  • Responsive iframe embed that scales with your layout
  • Optimized script (loads once per page)
  • Compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, and Classic Editor
  • Supports multiple feeds on one or multiple pages
  • Multiple layout options (Grid, Carousel, List, Showcase)
  • Post elements customization (title, channel name, views, likes)
  • Popup/video player support
  • Sorting and filter options
  • Call-to-action button support

Service description

The plugin does not process data or handle authentication inside WordPress.
It embeds the ready-made widget created in Mirror App.
All feed creation, account connection, moderation, and updates occur in Mirror App.
The WordPress plugin acts as a lightweight and secure embedding layer.

Service Links

  • Mirror App YouTube Feed
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

Legal Note

The plugin requires an active Mirror App account to create and manage widgets.
This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.
All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

Support

Need help?
– Help Center
– Post a topic in the WordPress Support Forum
– Email: support@mirror-app.com

Development

For developers: integration with vendor/iframe-bridge

The plugin uses the @mirrorapp/iframe-bridge library to manage iframe resizing and secure communication between WordPress and the embedded feed.

Key features:
– Auto iframe resizing
– Viewport sync between parent and child frames
– Lightweight client-side library (ESM/CJS/UMD supported)
– TypeScript support

Documentation: vendor/iframe-bridge/README.md
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mirror-app-video-feed/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to your Mirror App dashboard, connect your YouTube channels or playlists, customize your feed, and copy the shortcode.
  4. Paste the shortcode into any post, page, or widget area where you want the feed to appear.

⚠️ Note: This plugin does not handle YouTube authentication or API requests inside WordPress — it only embeds the ready-made widget from Mirror App.
Example: [mirror-app-video-feed 12345678-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-1234567890ab]
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills?

No. Simply copy the shortcode from Mirror App and paste it where you want the feed.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is free. Mirror App offers both free and paid plans with extended layouts and advanced features.

Is it responsive?

Yes. The embedded YouTube feed adjusts automatically to all screen sizes.

Where do I customize my feed?

All customization — layout, colors, connected channels, and moderation — happens in your Mirror App dashboard.

Can I show playlists instead of channels?

Yes — you can choose channels, playlists, or both as your feed sources.

Does the plugin handle authentication or API calls?

No. The plugin acts as a secure embed layer. All account connections and data processing occur within Mirror App.

How do I get support?

Visit our Help Center: https://mirror-app.com/help-center
Post a topic in the WordPress Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/mirror-app-video-feed
Email: support@mirror-app.com
